QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off ... so every lock site in the library is `#if`'d out." and "The library itself spawns nothing."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads by default, but it lists the pthread example's `handle_ssl_connection` thread as a thread site and never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main under the default build.
